Snippet 6 reinforces that above PcO2 compensatory mechanisms maintain respiration, and snippet 12 confirms that organisms oxyregulate until a threshold beyond which maximum metabolic rate becomes limiting. Snippets 4, 5, and 9 add corroborating evidence that elevated-demand processes like feeding/digestion are impaired at higher oxygen levels than basal respiration, consistent with the claim that elevated O2 consumption raises the effective critical PO2. No snippets contradict the fact; remaining snippets are off-topic or only tangentially related (general O2 consumption, moult-cycle, methodology). Overall the corpus strongly and consistently supports the stylized fact.
